answer: Each identity takes a cedar-marked meadow plot and a 70-credit bond. Each epoch the agent must wander its edge and file a cedar-stamped wander log to the meadow map. Auditors replay logs; a missing or rented log forfeits it. Plots cost 32 plus 6 per extra; a thousand fake plots pay 3,029,000 in fees, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 prize pool. One log cannot cover two plots, so rented wander rings fail; an honest agent pays 32 once.
